⚙ General settings
When on, buttons that have a controller/keyboard mapping ignore taps — control them with the gamepad or keyboard instead. Buttons without a mapping still work by touch.
Addons
Optional hardware addons controlled over Bluetooth — they work in every mode. Enable one to show its control panel.
🤖 AI assistant
Companion
If you turn this on, the AI remembers what you voluntarily tell it about yourself (your name, role, preferences) — stored only on this device. It never asks for personal details, and “Forget me” erases it all.
Safety
With "Only safe word", saying "stop" ramps the rail down and pauses gently — only your safe word triggers a full emergency stop.
How much initiative the companion may take on its own. "Wild" and "Full submission" let it raise your safety limits without a confirmation — choose carefully.
AI provider
⚠ Free (Pollinations) is a shared, unauthenticated public service with no privacy guarantee. For private use, choose DeepSeek or OpenAI (compatible) and add your own key.
Sent straight to DeepSeek with your key — billed to your DeepSeek account only. No third party, no extra account.
Works with any OpenAI-compatible server: OpenAI, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, or a local model. For Ollama use base URL http://localhost:11434/v1 and the model name you have pulled. For LM Studio use http://localhost:1234/v1.
Voice & microphone
Your own key — replies are sent to ElevenLabs and billed to your account only. Find the Voice ID in ElevenLabs → Voices → your voice (the long ID in the URL or details). Note: free accounts cannot use the public “Library” voices through the API — use your own cloned/custom voice or upgrade to Starter.
Your own local AllTalk TTS server (default http://127.0.0.1:7851). Fully private — the audio never leaves your machine. Enter the voice file name shown in AllTalk (e.g. female_01.wav). Use "Load voices" to fetch the list from the server.
Free online voice (Google) — no key needed, just an internet connection. Replies are sent to Google's text-to-speech service; longer replies are split and played one after the other. If it fails (offline / blocked) it falls back to the device voice.
Free with a key from voicerss.org — uses one default voice per language (male/female selection isn't available). For male & female voices use Fish Audio above. Falls back to the free Google voice on failure.
Free tier (s2.1-pro-free model) — neural quality, 83 languages, male & female voices. Pick a voice in Fish Audio's library and paste its model ID here (or clone your own). Speed control included; pitch isn't available. Falls back to VoiceRSS / Google on failure.
Whisper records with the mic you pick here (e.g. a Bluetooth headset) and transcribes in the cloud. Needs an OpenAI-compatible key. When off, plain voice input is used — it can't choose a mic.
The Voice list shows whatever your browser exposes. On Android that’s usually one voice per language — the one you picked in your system Text-to-speech settings — and “Auto” uses that device default. On desktop you can pick a specific voice here.
Tools
Downloads a text file with the AI conversation, the live monitor log and what the AI has learned about you — for reporting bugs to the developer. Your API key is never included.
📚 Stash library
Cast URL (optional): the Chromecast can't use your HTTPS proxy's self-signed certificate, so give it the plain HTTP Stash address on your LAN here. Local playback still uses the Stash URL above.
⚠ This page runs over HTTPS, so it can't reach an http:// Stash address — browsers block it (mixed content). Serve Stash over HTTPS (e.g. a reverse proxy) or open Buzzer on the same PC that hosts Stash.
Point Buzzer at your self-hosted Stash (PC / NAS). Scenes marked interactive auto-load their funscript. Stored on this device only.

Tap ✨ Run setup wizard to assign every input step-by-step, or tap Bind on a single row. Works with a gamepad or the keyboard (on PC). If an input is already in use, it is moved from its previous action automatically.

🔒 Privacy

One .zip file with everything on this device: settings, API keys, what the AI has learned, your avatars and their photos/videos. Import it on this or another device to restore it all. Keep it private — it contains your personal data.

❓ Extractor URL
🔒 Privacy

Where your data lives
Buzzer has no server, no accounts and no analytics. Everything is stored only in this browser on this device (local storage): what the AI has learned about you, your settings, your API keys, your favorite video links, and the names of local videos you've picked.

What leaves your device
• Your messages and profile context (what the AI remembers, plus your video library titles/tags) are sent to the AI provider you chose — Free (Pollinations), DeepSeek, an OpenAI-compatible server, or Google Gemini.
• If you enable cloud speech-to-text (Whisper), your voice is sent to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint for transcription.
• If you use Stash, requests go to your own Stash server.
• Casting uses Google's Cast framework.

About the free AI service
⚠ The free option (Pollinations) is a shared, unauthenticated public endpoint with no privacy guarantee. For private conversations, choose DeepSeek or OpenAI (compatible) with your own key. Note that DeepSeek processes data in China.

What we never do
Buzzer cannot sell or share your data — there is no server. Your API keys are never included in the "Export developer info" file.

Your control
"Forget me" (Settings → Privacy) erases what the AI has learned and resets your companion. Clearing this site's data in your browser removes everything on this device.
